scheme_name: AFFDF-Financial Assistance For Treatment Of Serious Diseases To Non Pensioner Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)/Widows
other_conditions: Applicant must be a non‑pensioner Ex‑Servicemen (all ranks) or his widow
Applicant should not be a member of ECHS or be availing AFMS facilities
Applicant must be recommended by the respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB)
Expenditure must be incurred at an approved government hospital at rates applicable under CGHS/ECHS
benefits_summary: Provides up to Rs 1,25,000 one‑time assistance (or Rs 75,000 per annum for cancer/dialysis) covering 75‑90% of medical expenses for non‑pensioner ex‑servicemen and their widows.
documents_required: Copies of the supporting documents duly attested by the respective Zila Sainik Welfare Officer (ZSWO)
